primary_inference: Early Fusion significantly outperforms all 3 alternative models on clean data (vs Energy-Only: Mean Diff = -6.25 W [-7.05, -5.49], p_holm = 8.52e-28; vs Late: -7.27 W [-8.04, -6.41], p_holm = 1.34e-37; vs Hybrid: -10.55 W [-11.45, -9.60], p_holm = 3.86e-51). Late Fusion vs Energy-Only is not statistically distinguishable (p_holm = 0.1197).

family_name: Family 2: Model Comparisons Under Missingness (30% MCAR)
primary_inference: Early Fusion maintains a statistically significant performance advantage over all models across all missingness conditions (N-A, A-N, A-A; all p_holm < 1e-16). Under dual missingness (A-A), Early Fusion outperforms Energy-Only by -10.62 W, Late Fusion by -6.75 W, and Hybrid Fusion by -8.21 W.

family_name: Family 3: Model Comparisons Under Noise (20% AWGN)
primary_inference: Early Fusion significantly outperforms all models under noise (all p_holm < 1e-16). Late Fusion vs Energy-Only is not significant under any noise condition (N-A, A-N, A-A; p_holm = 0.3489 to 0.6769).

Asymmetric modality vulnerability confirmed: Electricity missingness (A-N and A-A) causes large, highly significant error surges across all models (+1.89 W to +9.13 W, p_holm < 1e-15). Weather missingness (N-A) produces small effects that are non-significant for Energy-Only (0.0 W) and Early Fusion (+0.17 W, p_holm = 0.5604), and small for Late (+0.65 W) and Hybrid (+0.36 W).

Negligible noise sensitivity: Across all three multimodal models (Early, Late, Hybrid), noise degradation (N-A, A-N, A-A) produces no statistically significant error increase (all p_holm > 0.05, relative change <= 0.13%). Only Energy-Only under power noise (A-N, A-A) exhibits a slight statistically detectable change (+0.44 W, p_holm = 0.0013, dz = 0.18).

Missingness causes statistically greater error increases than noise across all models under electricity (A-N) and joint (A-A) degradation (p_holm < 1e-16; missingness excess: Energy-Only +8.69 W, Early +4.66 W, Late +4.14 W, Hybrid +2.39 W). Under weather-only degradation (N-A), differences are non-significant for Energy-Only (0.0 W) and Early Fusion (+0.11 W).
